digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter reconcilers (Cloud and Data Center)
propositions: Cloud adapter lacks test coverage for multi-page pagination and rate-limiting edge cases that Data Center adapter gained during development, while Data Center adapter lacks byte-for-byte field value characterization and comment/description length-convergence testing that Cloud has from production incidents

Data Center adapter's create-path field values, sanitizer boundaries, identity label form, and probe branches must be pinned by explicit expected value assertions rather than shape-only contract tests
A duplicated ticket-type map exists in the adapter codebase and must be single-sourced with a guard preventing re-duplication, analogous to existing guards on status and priority maps

Data Center comment and description fields that exceed limits must converge across multiple reconciliation passes with the ceiling's provenance (jira.text.field.character.limit and JRASERVER-28519) documented in source code
Five existing vacuous test cases must either assert their named contract or be renamed to reflect actual behavior, rather than deleted, to preserve documented intent

Cloud and Data Center adapters diverge legitimately in rich-text encoding (ADF vs wiki markup) and identity form (accountId vs name), and the characterization suite must explicitly parametrize these divergences with adapter-specific expected values
